metadata.name: Student Dashboard & Knowledge Visualization Evaluation
metadata.scientific_disclaimer: Controlled software and interface evaluation benchmark. Does NOT claim student learning gains, engagement improvements, or pedagogical effectiveness. Strictly evaluates presentation/application layer invariants: API contract compliance, domain mapping correctness, student isolation, source provenance preservation, honest missing source handling, recommendation rendering, assessment delegation, dynamic state refresh, empty/error state handling, and deterministic fixture rendering.

scenarios.name: Knowledge Graph Renders Canonical Concepts & Relations
scenarios.description: Verifies that GET /api/subjects/{subject_id}/graph returns complete nodes and directed edges matching the canonical academic graph.

scenarios.name: Concept Detail Drawer Loads Complete Academic Information
scenarios.description: Verifies that GET /api/concepts/{concept_id} returns prerequisites, dependents, description, type, and source chunk IDs.

scenarios.name: Student Knowledge State Overlay Appears Correctly
scenarios.description: Populates student interactions and confirms that knowledge score, confidence, and mastery status match backend domain calculations.

scenarios.name: Unassessed Concept Represented as UNKNOWN Without False Deficit
scenarios.description: Verifies that a student with 0 interactions on a concept has UNKNOWN mastery status, 0 evidence count, and baseline prior confidence (C <= 0.15).

scenarios.name: Conflicting Evidence Represented as UNCERTAIN Status
scenarios.description: Provides conflicting assessment outcomes (alternating 1.0 and 0.0) and verifies that status resolves to UNCERTAIN with has_conflicting_evidence flag.

scenarios.name: Recommendation Cards Match Phase 7B Planner Output
scenarios.description: Confirms that GET /api/students/{student_id}/recommendations returns cards identical in priority, action type, and reason codes to RecommendationService.

scenarios.name: Assessment Start Delegates to AdaptiveAssessmentService
scenarios.description: Initiating a session via POST /api/assessment/sessions returns an active session with adaptively selected item without client-side item selection.

scenarios.name: Assessment Response Reaches Backend Evaluator
scenarios.description: Submitting an answer via POST /api/assessment/sessions/{session_id}/responses grades deterministically and emits evidence event.

scenarios.name: Updated Knowledge State Reflected Immediately Post-Submission
scenarios.description: After an assessment response is submitted, subsequent queries to concept details or dashboard overview reflect the updated knowledge score and evidence count.

scenarios.name: Source Material Inspector Preserves Grounded Provenance
scenarios.description: Retrieving a valid chunk via GET /api/chunks/{chunk_id} returns document ID, page/section, text, and concept associations without fabrication.

scenarios.name: Missing Source Displayed Honestly as Source Unavailable
scenarios.description: Requesting a nonexistent chunk ID returns a 404 error, and concepts lacking indexed chunks report source_available=False.

scenarios.name: Student Privacy & Knowledge State Isolation Enforced
scenarios.description: Mutations to Student A's knowledge state do NOT bleed into or alter Student B's knowledge state or recommendations.

scenarios.name: Graceful Handling of Zero-Evidence Empty States
scenarios.description: A fresh student with no interaction logs yields a valid dashboard overview with 0 assessments, 0 recent activity, and descriptive unknown counts.

scenarios.name: Graceful Backend Error Handling on Invalid Requests
scenarios.description: Queries for nonexistent concepts or invalid sessions return clean HTTP 404 responses with structured error details, not unhandled 500 crashes.

scenarios.name: Deterministic API to Domain Model Serialization
scenarios.description: Verifies that repeated queries with identical backend state return bitwise deterministic JSON schemas without random nonces or floating drift.
